name: filetree
description: File tree pane for Claude Code: lazy folders, git status and the files Claude reads and writes

icons.title: File icons
icons.description: nerd: folder and file glyphs, needs a Nerd Font in the terminal. dot: a coloured square per file type, works in any font. none: names only.

github.title: GitHub pull request
github.description: Show the current branch's pull request, CI checks and review state. Runs the gh CLI and uses the network, with whichever gh account is active.

githubRefreshSeconds.title: GitHub refresh (seconds)
githubRefreshSeconds.description: How long a settled pull request is cached before gh is asked again (60 to 3600).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a session starts
autoOpen.description: Open the Files pane by itself at the start of every session. Off: it opens only when you run /filetree. The tree keeps following the session either way.
